speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing sudden-onset lower back pain that radiates down your leg; to determine the cause, could you tell me how many weeks or months you have had these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Disc Herniation.

The history of acute onset during exercise with radiation to the foot is highly suggestive of a disc herniation. To confirm this, I need to assess your neurologic status and check for a herniation on imaging. Would you mind if I performed a physical exam of your legs, and would you be willing to undergo an MRI?
